Callout.Name: Distillery Reported
Callout.Message: Copper tubing and drums seen on a hillside.

Script.Line: Copper tubing, drums, and a fire lit under it.
I have smelt that smell for a week and today I went and looked.
Nobody is about, but the fire is lit. So somebody is coming back.

Lines.Approach: Tubing and drums and nobody about. Somebody has gone to a lot of trouble out here.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
